claims.text: The hotel sits directly opposite Kensington Palace, with views across the gardens to the palace.

findings.quote: Situated directly opposite Kensington Palace, The Milestone Hotel & Residences offers exceptional views across the gardens to this most famous of homes.

claims.text: The hotel is part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection.

findings.quote: As part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection

claims.text: The hotel is in a Grade II listed Victorian building with a Kensington-style red and white brick facade.

findings.quote: Our Grade-II listed Victorian building, recognisable for its striking Kensington-style red and white brick facade

claims.text: No two rooms or suites are alike; rooms are decorated with fine fabrics, fresh flowers, antique furnishings and rare artworks.

findings.quote: adorned with fine fabrics, fresh flowers, antique furnishings and rare artworks. No two rooms or suites are alike

findings.quote: A timelessly elegant Grand Master Suite, with an iconic four-poster bed and collection of Hermès scarves.

claims.text: The Residences have two or three bedrooms, fully equipped kitchens and private access through their own front door.

findings.quote: With elegant two and three bedroom Residences, families can enjoy a refined London base with separate lounges, fully equipped kitchens and dining areas for family-style meals, plus the freedom of private access via your own front door.

claims.text: Cheneston's restaurant serves modern British cuisine.

findings.quote: Enjoy delicious modern British cuisine from Executive Chef Daniel Putz in our elegant restaurant.

claims.text: Traditional British afternoon tea is served in The Park Lounge.

findings.quote: Enjoy quintessentially British Traditional Afternoon Tea in the charming surroundings of The Park Lounge.

findings.quote: The Hideaway is a versatile new dining space that offers an exclusive and intimate setting for both exclusive private events and casual walk-ins. Adjacent to The Stables Bar, this dark wood-panelled, candlelit room

findings.quote: The resistance pool, cold plunge and infrared sauna provide a restorative setting to unwind and rebalance at your own pace.
You are welcome to enjoy our intimate wellness studio, with space for independent training

claims.text: The Natural History Museum and the Science Museum are nearby.
